mapper.select: SELECT pm.project_member_id AS memberId, pm.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, d.name AS department, pm.permission AS permission, (e.resigned_at IS NOT NULL) AS resigned, (e.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted FROM project_member pm LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = pm.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY e.name ASC, pm.user_id ASC
